name: Independents as Actors
description: Independent colonies defend themselves with small militia fleets, send construction ships to build mining stations in their home system and nearby unclaimed systems (never colonies), and may band together into leagues that pool their defence, share stations, reach out with a single colony and negotiate as a bloc. Includes the rim herders (off by default).

flags.name: independentActors
flags.label: Independents as actors
flags.description: Per independent colony, scaled by population: a militia fleet (defend home), an independent construction ship building mining stations nearby (no colony ships), freighters and a militia refresh when ships die. Stations in systems another empire claims become friction points (buy out / tolerate / clear). The independent empire's tech tree also drifts toward a share of the galaxy's median regular-empire tech level over time, so later militia and stations use better components.

flags.name: independentLeagues
flags.label: Independent leagues
flags.description: Nearby independent colonies under threat or prosperous may form a league: pooled defence, shared stations, exactly one extra colony, bloc diplomacy and dissolution.

flags.name: rimHerders
flags.label: Rim herders
flags.description: Herder independents (19j); their tamed creatures serve as their militia, construction ships and freighters.

flags.name: rimFauna
flags.label: Rim fauna herds
flags.description: Rim-weighted Kaltor herds (19g-7); needed by the rim herders.
